newsitem.title: PERU: Buses collide in Peruvian Andes killing 13.
newsitem.headline: Buses collide in Peruvian Andes killing 13.

text.p: A passenger bus slammed into a minivan in the Peruvian Andes killing 13 people and seriously injuring three more, authorities said Monday.
The crash ocurred near the highland town of Huancayo, 195 miles (310 km) east of Lima, as the two vehicles snaked along a mountain road in the dark late Sunday, fireman Raul Ferroa said.
All the victims were travelling aboard the smaller vehicle, which was was carrying 16 passengers.
There were no reports of injuries among the 50 passengers aboard the larger bus, which was travelling from the Andean town of Hunacavelica to the capital. The cause of the accident was not known.
The frequency of road crashes in Peru's Andes, where most people travel along poorly maintained roads on overloaded buses, has brought calls for tighter transport regulations.
